name: shortcut-sequence-recorder
title: ShortcutSequenceRecorder
description: Source-owned multi-chord shortcut sequence recorder backed by TanStack Hotkeys sequence recorder state and ShortcutDisplay.

meta.api: ShortcutSequenceRecorder is a button-like control with value, onValueChange, onCancel, onClear, recorderOptions, placeholder, recordingLabel, sequenceSeparator, and ShortcutDisplay formatOptions props.
meta.behavior: Clicking starts TanStack Hotkeys createHotkeySequenceRecorder. It previews current steps, commits through TanStack recorder options such as Enter or idleTimeoutMs, cancels on Escape, and clears through onValueChange([]).
meta.accessibility: ShortcutSequenceRecorder renders a native button, defaults type=button, sets aria-pressed while recording, and preserves caller labels through children. Applications should place it in a labelled settings row when editing sequence preferences.
meta.dataAttributes: Stable hooks use data-scope="ui-shortcut-sequence-recorder" and data-part values for trigger, label, value, and placeholder. Trigger exposes data-recording and data-empty.
meta.ssr: Rendering does not read browser globals. Sequence recording starts only from user interaction after hydration through TanStack Hotkeys recorder source.
meta.limitations: This records multi-step sequences only. Single-chord shortcuts can use ShortcutRecorder. Persistence, conflict resolution, and user preference storage stay in app-owned source.

parity.tanstackHotkeys: Wraps createHotkeySequenceRecorder and preserves sequence recorder options while adding generated UI markup and data attributes.
parity.shadcn: Source-owned settings-control ergonomics for command-heavy apps that need Vim-style sequence preference editing.
parity.keystoneCore: Does not add Core primitive behavior. It is an app settings control for user shortcut sequence preferences.
